column_description: A BIGSERIAL primary key for recommendation records (e.g., 3001).
An enum (recalgorithm_enum) describing the recommendation algorithm (Contextual, Content-based, Collaborative, Hybrid).
An enum (recstrategy_enum) capturing strategy used (Trending, Editorial, Similar, Personalized).
An INT for the recommendation position or rank in a list (e.g., 3).
An enum (recpage_enum) describing where the recommendation is displayed (Search, Category, Home, Article).
An enum (recsection_enum) describing the section used for recommendation (Bottom, Sidebar, Related, Top).
A NUMERIC(5,2) capturing the recommendation relevance or ranking score (e.g., 85.40).
A NUMERIC(5,2) rating how diverse the recommendation is (e.g., 20.00).
A BIGINT FK referencing Articles(ArtKey), linking recommended article with the recommendation record.
